label: Adapted Beauvoirian autonomy into a Mexican feminist ethics of pleasure
description: Building on existentialist freedom, Hierro rejected self-sacrificial Catholic-patriarchal morality to propose an ethics centered on female autonomy and embodied joy.
dialecticalTension: Transforms existential freedom into Latin American feminist moral philosophy.
historicalContext: Ética y feminismo (1985) & La ética del placer (2001).

label: Institutionalized Mexican feminist philosophy supporting Gargallo’s generation
description: By founding the Asociación Filosófica Feminista de México and UNAM’s PUEG, Hierro created the scholarly space in which Gargallo chronicled Latin American feminist ideas.
dialecticalTension: Institutional bridge from Mexican feminist ethics to Abya Yala feminist history.
